acceptance: Red-first: over each threshold the sentinel emits one HOST_* signal with the value and the threshold; a repeat within the interval does not flood.
At shadow it releases nothing; at enforce it releases only the safe scopes, and a test proves that a live lane's worktree, sessions and processes are untouched.
A gc lease held by the boundary makes the sentinel skip, not wait.
Below the floor no new lane starts, and running lanes continue.
The sentinel stops with the loop and leaves no process; a failed sample warns and never stops the loop.
Docs: a spec section with the at-least-three approaches studied, live research per the docs rule, wave-operations and signal codes; 100% coverage on each changed function; zero code comments.
fix: Add the sentinel with a policy block (interval, thresholds, floor, stage shadow then enforce). Split gc into scopes marked safe during a wave: LRU trim of the Go cache, stale pipeline temp, and orphan processes with the existing ownership proof (ppid 1 and a closed cycle). Live run dirs, worktrees, dispatch processes and sockets of a live lease stay boundary-only. At shadow it only emits the signal and what it would release. wave status shows the last sample. The boundary gc stays.
routed_reason: console PR 1292 holds this build; cycle 2155 had a partial duplicate
source: operator decision 2026-11-04: 'add the rule that it should detect the system and tmux status in the background when evo loop / wave / cycle is running'; picked the sentinel inside the loop. Evidence: gc runs only at boundaries (boundary step 10, loop pre-batch, batch-end), a wave runs 9 to 13 hours, the host reached 273 MB free with a 138 GB Go cache, and 324 orphan processes piled up 3 to 6 hours old.
summary: Nothing watches the host between boundaries. The sentinel is a background task of the loop process, beside the oversight task. It wakes on a policy timer and on each cycle seal, samples free disk, Go cache size, tmux server count, orphan process count and load, and emits typed HOST_* signals. Over a policy threshold it runs only the gc scopes that are safe during a wave, under the existing gc lease. Below a disk floor it holds new lane starts. It works on each OS through the existing process and disk helpers.
title: A host sentinel inside the loop detects disk, cache, tmux, orphan and load trouble during a wave and runs the mid-wave-safe gc scopes
